name: Bedhampton
notes: Full-barrier crossing immediately east (Havant side) of the platforms, which run 27–173 m west of it (OSM). Also used by Fareham–Havant trains that never call at Portsmouth. 12 coaches assumed when Darwin gives no length: a westbound 12-car would stand with its rear on the road — confirm on site.

name: Petersfield
notes: Full-barrier crossing at the London end of the platforms, which run 7–302 m south of it (OSM) — long enough for a 12-car to clear the road. Rebuilt with new barriers in autumn 2025.

name: Kingsfernsden Lane
notes: Automatic half barriers 0.9 km north of Petersfield station. Upgraded autumn 2025 — barrier type may have changed.

name: Sheet
notes: 1.2 km north of Petersfield. Barrier type not tagged in OSM; new barriers fitted autumn 2025 per Network Rail — confirm on site. Network Rail's July 2025 crossing list gives AHB (half barriers).

name: Princes Bridge
notes: 1 km south of Liss station. Barrier type not tagged in OSM; new barriers fitted autumn 2025 — confirm on site. Network Rail's July 2025 crossing list gives AHB (half barriers).

name: Liss
notes: Full-barrier crossing at the Portsmouth end of the platforms, which run 11–180 m north of it (OSM). A southbound train crosses then stops; a 12-car stands with its rear on the road and the barriers stay down for its whole stop — confirmed on site 2026-09-20. An 8-car clears. Darwin gives SWR no length, so 12 is assumed.

name: Mill Road
notes: 0.7 km north of Liss station. Barrier type not tagged in OSM — confirm on site. Network Rail's July 2025 crossing list gives AHB (half barriers).

name: Milford
notes: Automatic half barriers at the south end of Milford station: platforms run 19–212 m north of the road (OSM). A northbound train crosses, then stops; anything longer than ~10 coaches stands with its rear on the crossing, so the barriers stay down until it leaves — seen with a 12-car on 2026-09-19 (reported via the app), hence assumeCoaches 12 while Darwin gives no length for SWR.

name: Farncombe
notes: Full-barrier crossing at the Godalming end of the platforms, which run 16–267 m north of it (OSM): a 12-car just clears the road.

name: Bourne Road
notes: Full-barrier crossing at the Guildford end of Farncombe station, 330 m from the Farncombe Street crossing; the platforms end 98 m short of it (OSM), so a northbound train is on the road ~20 s after pulling away.
